senses.gloss:
Kacapañjara_(?)
Kṛṣṇastotra; from Brahmasaṁhitā (Trailokyavijayagopālamantrātmaka). BORI. 482 (ii) of 1895-98. BORI. D. XIII. iii. 834.

Kacādivṛtti
gr. short treatise on Kātantra. IO. 5061 (4).

Kaccavācakapāli
Bud. Pāli. by Sattamaguru. Cabaton II. 704 (iv).

Kaccavācakanissāya
Bud. Pāli. Cabaton II. 704 (v..

Kaccāyana
Bud. Pāli writer, different from the Pāli grammarian; before Buddhaghoṣa.
--Nettiprakaraṇa.
--Peṭakopadeśa.

Kaccāyana
Pāli grammarian; of India; later than Buddhaghoṣa; uses Kātantra an. Kāśikā; before 12th cent. A. D.
--Kaccāyanavyākaraṇa or K. gandha.
--Cullaniruttigandha. gr.
--Mahāniruttigandha.
--Vaṇṇanītigandha.
--Susandhikappa, earlier work forming the basis of the K. vyākaraṇa. [Page115-a.
On him an. his gr., see Gandhavaṁsa JPTS. 1886, p. 59, d'Alwis, An Intro. to Ka.'s Gr. of Pāli Lang., Colombo, 1863; R. O. Franke, PāliGrammatīk und-Lexikographie, Strassburg, 1902. Geiger, Pāli Lit. an. Lang. Eng. transl. p.. 48. 49; Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma, p. 29; Ind. Cult. XV. p. 198.

Kaccāyanagandha
See below Kaccāyanavyākaraṇa.

Kaccāyanadhātumañjūsā
so called because it follows Kaccāyana's school; by Thera-Sīlavaṁsa; in 150 verses; on the model of Vopadeva's Kavikalpadruma.
See under Dhātumañjūsā.

Kaccāyananiddeso
Pāli. gr. Colombo p. 55. C.. K. suttaniddesa, C. on K. yoga.

Kaccāyananissaya
Pāli. gr. one of the texts mentioned in the list found in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D.
See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma, p. 106. “Pāli tracts in inscriptions” in the J. Myth. Soc. XXII. p. 412.

Kaccāyanapadavigraha
Pāli. gr. based on K.'s gr. Colombo D. I. 2087. 2088.

Kaccāyanappakaraṇa
Pāli. gr. one of the titles of Kaccāyanavyākaraṇa.
--C. Ṭīkā. Colombo p. 55. IO. Pāli p. 90 (no. 65).
--C. Gandhamaraṇa ṭīkā. Paris Pāli p. 37 (2 mss.).

Kaccāyana_Bheda,_Ka._Bhe._Ppakaraṇa,_Ka._Bhe._Dīpikā
Pāli. gr. in verse; based on Kaccāyana's; sometimes described a. a C. on Kaccāyana's gr. by Thera Mahāyasa of Burma, C. second half of 14th cent. A. D.; but ascribed to Rassathera by Fausbo7ll; Gandhavaṁsa mentions the a. a. Dharmānanda. Cabaton II. 498 (i). 499 (i). 695 (iii). Colombo p. 55 (2 mss.). Colombo [Page115-b] D. I. 2081. Fausbo7ll 148. 152. Paris Pāli p. 37.
Pt.. Colombo, 1886.
--C. Navaṭīkā. Cabaton II. 532-33. Paris Pāli p. 37 (2 mss.).
--C. Purāṇa-ṭīkā (Sāratthapakāsinī ?). Cabaton II. 498 (ii). Paris Pāli p. 37.
--C. Sāratthavikāsinī by Ariyālaṁkāra of Burma. Written in 1608 A. D. Fausbo7ll 154. See also NCC. I. p. 274a an. Bode, Pāli. Lit. of Burma, p.. 37. 55.
Pt.. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 77.
--C. Mahāṭīkā by Uttamasikkha. Colombo D. I. 2082. See also NCC. II. p. 299b.
Pt.. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1906-28. 1141.

Kaccāyanabhedanissāya
Cabaton II. 696 (v.).

Kaccāyanabhedapāṭha
Pāli. Cabaton II. 696 (v.. See above K. bheda.

Kaccāyanabhedamañjūsā
Pāli. gr. based on Kaccāyana's work. by Sīlavaṁsa Thera of Yakkhyādilena. Colombo D. I. 2083-86.

Kaccāyanayoga
Pāli. gr. a name of the Sūtras of K. vyākaraṇa. See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma, p. 21.
--C. Nyāsa or Mukhamatta(sāra)dīpanī by Vimalabuddhi (before 12th cent. A. D.). Cabaton II. 444. Colombo p. 55. Colombo D. I. 2103. Fausbo7ll 149.
Pt.. (1) Rangoon, 1909. (2) with C. Vutti ascribed to Saṅghanandi an. Appendix on nouns etc., IInd edn. Colombo, 1910.
--C.. on Nyāsa, Niruttisāramañjūsā by Dāṭhanāga Rājaguru. Colombo D. I. 2112. [Page116-a.
--C.. Ṭīkā on Nyāsa. by another Vimalabuddhi (?) See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma, p. 21.
--C.. Nyāsappadīpa by Chapaḍa (end of 12th cent. A. D.). Fausbo7ll 153.
--C. Sammohavighātani. Cabaton II. 443 (Sandhi).
--C. Suttaniddesa by Chapaḍa (C. 1181 A. D.) alias Saddhamma Jotipāla; composed a. Pagan in 1181 A. D. Colombo D. I. 2091.
See Geiger, Pāli Lit. an. Lang., Eng. transl., Cal. Uni., 1943, p. 50.
Ed.. in Sinhalese script, Colombo, 1905. 1915.

Kaccāyanarūpāvatāra
mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D.
See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma, p. 109 an. “Pāli tracts in inscriptions” in the J. Myth. Soc. XXII. p. 413. See also Rūpāvatāra.

Kaccāyanavaṇṇanā
Pāli. gr. earlier work; mentioned in intro. verses in Rūpasiddhi.

Kaccāyanavaṇṇanā
Pāli. gr.; a later work of C. 1600 or 1626 A. D. by Thera Mahāvijitāvin of Burma.
This is a C. on Kaccāyana's Sandhikappa.
Cabaton II. 442. Colombo p. 55. Colombo D. I. 2092. Fausbo7ll 150. 151. Filliozat II. p. 14 (3 mss.).
See Geiger, Pāli Lit. an. Lang. Eng. transl. Cal. Uni. 1943. p.. 52-3.
Pt.. Rangoon, 1906.

Kaccāyanavyākaraṇa,_Ka._Gandha,_Ka._Pakaraṇa
Pāli. gr. by Kaccāyana. Said to be based on the earlier work Sandhikappa of Kaccāyana. According to K. bheda, the sūtras are by Kaccāyana, Vutti by Saṅghanandi [Page116-b] an. prayoga by Brahmadatta.
In 8 sections an. in about 687 sūtras. See (1) d'Alwis, An Intro. to K.'s Gr., Colombo, 1863. (2) with transl. an. Chresthomathy, F. Mason, Taungoo, 1868 for A. S. Bengal, Bib. Ind. 59. (3) with Fr. transl. an. Notes, E. Senart, J.. Ser. VI. Vol. XVII. 1871, p.. 193-351; 361-540. (4) with Eng. transl., S. C. Vidyabhushan, Calcutta, 1901. (5) Recent edn. with Hindi transl. of L. N. Tiwari an. B. Sharma, Tara Publications, Varanasi, 1962.
Alwis p.. 39-70. Br. Mus. Pāli p. 143 (4 mss.; mūla Kac.). Cabaton II. 424-441 (with Sinhalese gloss). 445 (1-5 sections). 463 (Samjñā an. Sandhi). 475 (i). 486. 584. 633. 673-4. 675 (7 sections). 676 (10 sections). 684 (7 sections). Colombo p. 55. Filliozat II. p. 14 (2 mss.). Fausbo7ll 143-7. 152. IO. Pāli p.. 86 (no. 55). 87 (nos. 56-61). 89 (no. 63). 91 (nos. 66-68, inc.). 92 (no. 69, inc.). Paris Pāli p. 36 (several mss. an. fr..). Providence Pāli no. 22.
--Ākhyāta of. Cabaton II. 470-73. 506.
--Uṇādi of. Cabaton II. 475. 480. 483-5. Paris Pāli p. 36 (2 mss.).
--Kāraka of. Cabaton II. 474-5. 481.
--Kiñcidhānakappa of. Cabaton II. 478-9.
--Kṛt of. Cabaton II. 476-7.
--Taddhita of. Cabaton II. 464-9.
--Dhātupāṭha of. Cabaton II. 482. Paris Pāli p. 36. See edn. p. 36. Dhātumañjūsā, D. Anderson an. H. Smith, Copenhagen, 1921.
--Dhātu an. Ākhyāta of. Cabaton II. 482. Paris Pāli p. 36. [Page117-a.
--Dhātu an. Uṇādi of. Paris Pāli p. 36 (2 mss.).
--Nāmakappa of. Cabaton II. 447. 451-4. 456-7. 501. 509. 512. 521. 522.
--C. on above. Cabaton II. 446. 448. 449. 450. 455.
--Sandhikappa of. Cabaton II. 463. 486 (Burnouf's Notes). 521. 522. 527. 706 (i). Colombo D. I. 2089-90. Copen. Pāli p. 149. Oxf. Pāli p. 31.
--C. on above, Yojanā or Sandhirūpadīpanī. Paris Pāli 36 (inc.).
--C. K. vaṇṇanā. by Mahāvijitāvin. See K. vaṇṇanā.
--Samāsakappa. Cabaton II. 458. 460. 463.
--C. on above. Cabaton II. 459. 461. 462.
--C. a.. Fausbo7ll 145. IO. Pāli p.. 86 (no. 55). 90 (no. 64). 91 (nos. 66-68. inc.). 92 (no. 69. inc.). Paris Pāli p. 36.
--C. Dīpanī. See B. C. Law, His.. Pāli. Lit. II, p. 636.

Kaccāyanasāyappakaraṇa
Pāli. Cabaton II. 695 (v.).

Kaccāyanasāra
Pāli gr. with a C. (Purāṇa Ṭīkā ?). by Mahāyaśa. C. 13th-14th cent. A. D.
Gandhavaṁsa ascribes this an. a C. on it to Dhammānanda. See JPTS. 1886, p. 68.
Cabaton II. 500 (i). 704 (i. ii). Copen. Pāli p. 149. Fausbo7ll 148 (a. noted a. Rassa Thera). Paris Pāli p. 36. It is one of the texts mentioned in the list found in a. inscription a. Pagan d. 1442 A. D.
See Bode, Pāli Lit. of Burma, p.. 36, 37, 106; “Pāli tracts in inscriptions” in the J. Myth. Soc. XXII. p. 411.
Ed. with Sinhalese transl., Welitota, Ceylon, 1892.
--C. Abhinavaṭīkā, Sammohavināsinī. by [Page117-b] Saddhammavilāsa of Pagan. Fausbo7ll 154.
--C. Ṭīkā. Cabaton II. 500 (iii) (ends in Taddhita-niddesa). Paris Pāli p. 36.
--C. Yojanā. Cabaton II. 500 (ii). Copen. Pāli p. 149. Paris Pāli p. 36.

Kaccāyanasāranissāya
Pāli gr.
--C. on above ? Br. Mus. Pāli II. p. 110. Cabaton II. 704 (iii).

Kaccāyanasāravivaraṇa
See Gandhavaṁsa, JPTS. 1886, p.. 65. 75; 1896. p. 57.

Kaccāyanasutta
Bud. Pāli. same a. K. vyākaraṇa (?) Cabaton II. 409. Fausbo7ll 148.

Kaccāyanasuttaniddesa
or suttaniddesa by Chapaḍa. See above under C.s on K. Yoga.

Kacciraṅganṛpatistotra
in praise of Kacciraṅgappa Oḍayār, Zamindar of Uḍaiyārpālayam in Tiruchi D.., Madras. MT. 3869 (e) (inc.). 5567 (b) (inc.).

Kacchapayantra
Bharatpur XVI. 162.

Kacchaparūpadhāribhagavatstotra
in 4 verses. (namaskurmaH kUrmaM etc.) on Viṣṇu in his Tortoise incarnation.
Pt.. Br. St. Ratnākara, p. 352, Pandita Pustakalaya, Benares, 1950.

Kacchapuṭa(ṭī)
IO. 6104A (Paṭalas 1-7 an. p.. of 8) an. MD. 7778 (inc. Mantrakhaṇḍa 23 chs.; chs. 5. 6. 20. 21 missing). Same text a. Rasaratnākara Mantrakhaṇḍa ascribed to Nityanātha but with a few additional intro. verses mentioning a. a. or a.'s guru a Narasiṁha of Bhārgavagotra an. Āpast. sūtra. However the cols. here mention Siddha Nāgārjuna a. a.
See above under Kakṣapuṭa.

Kacchapuṭaprayoga
Burnell 208b (no. 12243). TD. XX. Sup. no. 1004.
--from Ākāśabhairavakalpa. Burnell [Page118-a. 208b (no. 12155). TD. XX. Sup. no. 909.

Kacchapuṭaśvetārkagaṇapatikalpa
mantra. Mysore I. p. 668.

Kacchapurāṇa
Harshe p. 42.

Kacchapeśayajvan
of Ālūra family, father of the a.. a. of Nyāyakaustubha (MT. 3923).

Kacchapeśvara
father of Mṛtyuñjayasūri (a. of Prāsādadīpikā, Adyar).

Kacchapeśvaradīkṣita
of Brahmadeśa in North Arcot D.., Madras, son of Vāsudevayajvan an. grandson of Kālahastīśvarayajvan (C. on Bhāgavata).
--Rāmacandrayaśobhūṣaṇa, alaṁk. in three paricchedas, eulogising Bommarāja, Zamindar of Karvetnagar in North Arcot D.. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 76. MD. 12950. MT. 5666 (inc.).

Kacchapeśvaradīkṣita
one of the donees of Tiruviśanallūr gifted to scholars a. Śāhajirājapuram by King Shahaji of Tanjore (A. D. 1684-1710).
See V. Raghavan, p. 39. Intro. to his edn. of Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa, Tanjore Sar. Mah. Ser. No. 54.

Kaccheśa
father of the a.. a. on Prāyaścittaprayoga. Baroda 6174 (d).

Kācasomavrata
dh. TA. 610/2.

Kācājyosya
or kAzAjyosya (?) jy. by Daivajña Śiromaṇi. Burnell 78b. TD. 11456. [Page299-a.
